## FOLLOW-UP VISIT - 03/14/2024 

PATIENT Dax Vance 

DOB 04/12/2001 

MRN 940-2281-A 

DATE OF SERVICE 03/14/2024 

PAIN TODAY (0-10) 

3/10 

Final clinical orthopedic assessment. Incisions are maturely scarred. Bony healing is stable and robust. However, patient has reached maximum medical improvement (MMI). Significant permanent disability of the left arm is noted, with persistent loss of elbow flexion/extension (15 degrees deficit) and wrist supination (20 degrees deficit). Sensation over the left radial aspect of the hand remains permanently blunted. Persistent mild-to-moderate chronic neck pain continues. 

Reviewed medications, function, and goals. Time spent: 25 minutes, >50% counseling/coordination.

## FINDINGS

Distal radioulnar joint alignment is maintained. 

## IMPRESSION 

Well-healed left humerus and left distal radius fractures with stable internal hardware.
